scripts.setup: uv --directory backend sync && npm --prefix frontend install && npm install
scripts.gen:types: uv --directory backend run python scripts/export_openapi.py && npm --prefix frontend run gen:types
scripts.check: npm test && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.dev:api:watch: uv --directory backend run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --reload-dir app --port 8000
